usages.explain: Goes with nouns indicating "now," "at this moment"... to describe a current state of time.

examples.content: 今のところ彼女の母は危篤だ。
examples.transcription: いまのところかのじょのはははきとくだ。
examples.mean: Her mother is currently in critical condition.

examples.content: 現在のところ参加者は約２００人ほどです。
examples.transcription: げんざいのところさんかしゃはやくにぜろぜろにんほどです。

title: ... のところ => now, this time, recently
